passages.text: For the choirmaster, to be accompanied by flutes. A Psalm of David.
passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm.\r\nHe gave it to the choirmaster.\r\nThe choirmaster should use flutes to accompany it.

passages.text: Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He gave it to the choirmaster.
He wanted it played with flutes.
David speaks to the LORD.
He asks the LORD to listen to his words.
He asks the LORD to pay attention to his groaning.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶֽל־ הַנְּחִיל֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ אֲמָרַ֖י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה׀ יְהוָ֗ה בִּ֣ינָה הֲגִֽיגִי׃

passages.text: Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David calls God his King.
David calls God his God.
David asks God to listen to his cry.
David prays to God.
David directs his prayer only to God.
passages.original: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה׀ לְק֬וֹל שַׁוְעִ֗י מַלְכִּ֥י וֵאלֹהָ֑י כִּֽי־ אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ אֶתְפַּלָּֽל׃

passages.text: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD hears me.
I speak to the LORD in the morning.
I pray to the LORD at daybreak.
I bring my requests to the LORD early each day.
I wait for the LORD to answer me.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה בֹּ֭קֶר תִּשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלִ֑י בֹּ֥קֶר אֶֽעֱרָךְ־ לְ֝ךָ֗ וַאֲצַפֶּֽה׃

passages.text: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.
passages.sermon:
God does not desire wickedness.
God never delights in evil.
No evil can live with God.
Evil cannot remain in God's presence.
passages.original: כִּ֤י׀ לֹ֤א אֵֽל־ חָפֵ֘ץ רֶ֥שַׁע׀ אָ֑תָּה לֹ֖א יְגֻרְךָ֣ רָֽע׃

passages.text: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.
passages.sermon:
God does not allow the proud to stand before Him.
God hates everyone who does evil.
God sees all people clearly.
God rejects those who act with arrogance.
God opposes all who do wrong.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יִתְיַצְּב֣וּ הֽ֭וֹלְלִים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׂ֝נֵ֗אתָ כָּל־ פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

passages.text: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.
passages.sermon:
God does not tolerate lies.
God destroys people who speak lies.
The LORD hates people who commit violence.
The LORD hates people who act with deceit.
passages.original: תְּאַבֵּד֮ דֹּבְרֵ֪י כָ֫זָ֥ב אִישׁ־ דָּמִ֥ים וּמִרְמָ֗ה יְתָ֘עֵ֥ב׀ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.
passages.sermon:
God shows great loving devotion.
Because of Your great loving devotion, I will enter Your house.
I will bow down toward Your holy temple.
I will do this with reverence.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּרֹ֣ב חַ֭סְדְּךָ אָב֣וֹא בֵיתֶ֑ךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה אֶל־ הֵֽיכַל־ קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is righteous.
I have enemies.
LORD, lead me in Your righteousness.
Guide me because of my enemies.
Make Your way straight before me.
passages.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ נְחֵ֬נִי בְצִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ לְמַ֥עַן שׁוֹרְרָ֑י הוֹשַׁר לְפָנַ֣י דַּרְכֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.
passages.sermon:
The wicked speak lies.
No word from their mouths can be trusted.
Evil fills their hearts.
Destruction lives inside them.
Their throats are like open graves.
Their tongues speak deceit.
They use their words to mislead.
passages.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֪ין בְּפִ֡יהוּ נְכוֹנָה֮ קִרְבָּ֪ם הַ֫וּ֥וֹת קֶֽבֶר־ פָּת֥וּחַ גְּרוֹנָ֑ם לְ֝שׁוֹנָ֗ם יַחֲלִֽיקוּן׃

passages.text: Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.
passages.sermon:
God, you are holy and just.
Declare these people guilty, O God.
Let them fall because of their own plans.
They have committed many sins.
Drive them out for their many wrongdoings.
They have rebelled against you.
passages.original: הַֽאֲשִׁימֵ֨ם׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים יִפְּלוּ֮ מִֽמֹּעֲצ֪וֹתֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּרֹ֣ב פִּ֭שְׁעֵיהֶם הַדִּיחֵ֑מוֹ כִּי־ מָ֥רוּ בָֽךְ׃

passages.text: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.
passages.sermon:
All who take refuge in God can rejoice.
They can always shout for joy.
God can shelter them.
Those who love God's name can rejoice in God.
passages.original: וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ כָל־ ח֪וֹסֵי בָ֡ךְ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְ֭רַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ימוֹ וְֽיַעְלְצ֥וּ בְ֝ךָ֗ אֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.
passages.sermon:
The LORD blesses the righteous.
The LORD gives good things to those who do right.
The LORD surrounds the righteous with His favor.
His favor protects them like a shield.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּה֮ תְּבָרֵ֪ךְ צַ֫דִּ֥יק יְהוָ֑ה כַּ֝צִּנָּ֗ה רָצ֥וֹן תַּעְטְרֶֽנּוּ׃
